# Bing

4 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 2 standard (1 credit), 2 advanced (5) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

## GET /v1/bing/rank - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns whether a domain or a URL path ranks on Bing for a search, its best position, and every matching result with its position, link, title and page, scanning up to 200 positions in one call.

**Use when** you want to track where a site ranks on Bing for a keyword, including positions search does not reach.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - The search to check, for example best running shoes. · e.g. `best running shoes`
- `url` (required) - The site to look for: a domain (example.com, matching its subdomains) or a URL with a path (example.com/blog, matching pages under it). · e.g. `runnersworld.com`
- `market` (optional, string) - Bing market, for example en-US, en-GB, de-DE or ja-JP (38 in all). Default en-US.
- `country` (optional, string) - Two-letter country, only when it should differ from the market's.
- `language` (optional, string) - Language code such as en or de, only when it should differ from the market's.
- `safe_search` (optional, enum: strict | moderate | off) - strict, moderate or off.
- `time_range` (optional, enum: any | day | week | month | year) - any, day, week, month or year: only pages published or updated within it.
- `device` (optional, enum: desktop | mobile) - desktop or mobile: which results page to read.
- `depth` (optional, integer, 1-200) - Organic positions to scan, 1 to 200. Default 100. One call at any depth.
- `all_matches` (optional, boolean) - true to scan the whole depth and report every matching position. Default false (stop at the first results page with a match).
- `include_subdomains` (optional, boolean) - false to count only the exact domain. Default true.

**Response** `Analytics` object at `data` (inferred from a sample): {query string, target string, found boolean, position number, depth number, depth_scanned number, end_of_results boolean}; `matches[]` {position number, url string, title string, page number}.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/bing/rank" \
  --data-urlencode "query=best running shoes" \
  --data-urlencode "url=runnersworld.com" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/bing/search - 1 credit (standard)

Returns Bing's first page of organic results for a search, each with its position, title, link, displayed address, domain, site name, snippet and date, plus Bing's estimated result count, a corrected query, related searches and People Also Ask questions where Bing shows them. Bing's deeper pages are not served; GET /v1/bing/rank scans up to 200 positions for one domain.

**Use when** you want it for the top Bing results of a search. Only the first page is served, so chain rank to check deeper positions for a domain.
**Cost** cache 120 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** single page - Bing serves page 1 only: its page 2 failed 2 of 2 on the primary and repeated page 1 on the second step (measured 06/11/2026).

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - The search, for example best running shoes. · e.g. `best running shoes`
- `market` (optional, string) - Bing market, for example en-US, en-GB, de-DE or ja-JP (38 in all). Default en-US.
- `country` (optional, string) - Two-letter country, only when it should differ from the market's.
- `language` (optional, string) - Language code such as en or de, only when it should differ from the market's.
- `safe_search` (optional, enum: strict | moderate | off) - strict, moderate or off.
- `time_range` (optional, enum: any | day | week | month | year) - any, day, week, month or year: only pages published or updated within it.
- `device` (optional, enum: desktop | mobile) - desktop or mobile: which results page to read.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-10) - Results to return, 1 to 10. Default 10.

**Response** `SearchResult` rows at `data.items[]` (inferred from a sample): {position number, title string, url string, displayed_url string, domain string, site_name string, snippet string, date string}.

Page-level: `data.corrected_query`, `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.people_also_ask`, `data.related_searches`, `data.total_results`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/bing/search" \
  --data-urlencode "query=best running shoes" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/bing/suggestions - 1 credit (standard)

Returns the completions Bing suggests for a partial query.

**Use when** you want to see how people finish a search, for keyword ideas or autocomplete.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** single page - One results page per call; there is no next page (measured 06/11/2026).

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - A partial search, for example best running sh. · e.g. `best running sh`
- `market` (optional, string) - Bing market, for example en-US, en-GB, de-DE or ja-JP (38 in all). Default en-US.

**Response** `SearchResult` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ text }` (inferred from a sample): {text string}.

Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/bing/suggestions" \
  --data-urlencode "query=best running sh" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/bing/videos - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns Bing Videos results with hosting site, channel, duration, age, view count and thumbnail.

**Use when** you want to find videos on a topic across hosting sites in one search.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** single page - One results page per call; there is no next page (measured 06/11/2026).

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - The search, for example nike ad. · e.g. `nike ad`
- `market` (optional, string) - Bing market, for example en-US, en-GB, de-DE or ja-JP (38 in all). Default en-US.
- `country` (optional, string) - Two-letter country, only when it should differ from the market's.
- `language` (optional, string) - Language code such as en or de, only when it should differ from the market's.
- `safe_search` (optional, enum: strict | moderate | off) - strict, moderate or off.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-30) - Videos to return, 1 to 30. Default 30.

**Response** `SearchResult` rows at `data.items[]` (inferred from a sample): {position number, title string, url string, publisher string, channel string, duration string, age string, views string, thumbnail_url string}.

Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/bing/videos" \
  --data-urlencode "query=nike ad" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## Withdrawn endpoints (do not call)

These stay registered but return `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` today and never bill. A permanent withdrawal is not coming back - use the alternative named in the platform's other endpoints rather than retrying.

- `GET /v1/bing/news` - temporarily withdrawn while its data source is re-established. Returns `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` and never bills; check the changelog before retrying.
